combinations.magnitude: co-treatment enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA (reduced viability, increased apoptosis)
combinations.evidence_quote: Functionally, the depletion of SPP1 or BTX-A inhibited cell viability and induced apoptosis of LPS-treated microglia, and co-treatment with BTX-A enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA on LPS-treated microglia (Figure 2C-E), indicating that SPP1 targeted by BTX-A promotes proliferation and represses apoptosis in LPS-induced microglia.

combinations.magnitude: co-treatment enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA
combinations.evidence_quote: We observed that the levels of GSDMD-N, NLPRP3, and ASC were repressed by SPP1 knockdown or BTX-A treatment in LPS-treated microglia and that co-treatment with BTX-A enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA on pyroptosis in LPS-treated microglia (Figure 3A-C).

combinations.magnitude: co-treatment showed a more observable effect than either alone
combinations.evidence_quote: Consistently, SPP1 depletion or BTX-A treatment was able to inhibit the levels of TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β in LPS-treated microglia, and SPP1 shRNA and BTX-A co-treatment presented a more observable effect on the phenotype (Figure 3D-F), indicating that SPP1 targeted by BTX-A contributes to pyroptosis of LPS-induced microglia.

combinations.readout: mechanical withdrawal threshold and thermal withdrawal latency
combinations.magnitude: co-treatment enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA
combinations.evidence_quote: We observed that the mechanical withdrawal threshold and thermal withdrawal latency were promoted by SPP1 knockdown or BTX-A in rats with SNI, whereas co-treatment with BTX-A enhanced the effect of SPP1 shRNA (Figure 4A and B).

combinations.magnitude: co-treatment enhanced the effect of SPP1 depletion
combinations.evidence_quote: Consistently, the levels of TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β were repressed by BTX-A or SPP1 depletion in rats with SNI, and co-treatment with BTX-A could enhance the effect of SPP1 depletion (Figure 4E-G).
